newsitem.title: UK: UK fin. services to tap affinity groups - report.
newsitem.headline: UK fin. services to tap affinity groups - report.

text.p: Affinity groups are set to become a more important market for UK financial service providers selling loans, credit cards and insurance, management consultancy Datamonitor said on Monday.
"Datamonitor expects revenue from sales through affinity groups to rise by 7.5 percent per year, reaching almost 20 billion stg by 2000," it said in a report 'UK Affinity Groups'.
This compares with sales of 13 billion stg in 1996, or 2.4 percent of total revenue from loans, credit cards and insurance.

Datamonitor said affinity groups represented one of the most promising channels for marketing such products, adding that growth would be driven by the trend towards private provision of health-care insurance, education and pensions.
Affinity groups, which include trade unions, professions and clubs, allow companies to cut their marketing costs and potentially increase sales.
